title: Relay Ready Request Persistence Contract
description: Canonical additive-tolerant full relay-ready request persistence contract. The top-level schema defines the input accepted by skills/relay-ready/scripts/persist-request.js. $defs.RequestArtifact and $defs.HandoffArtifact document the persisted frontmatter artifacts generated for downstream relay-plan and relay-dispatch consumers. The CLI validates only the input shape before relay-request.js performs semantic normalization and artifact persistence.

source.description: Origin metadata for the request. Unknown source metadata is preserved as producer-specific context.

kind.description: Source type for the request, such as raw_text or github_issue.

request_text.description: Raw user request text to persist as raw-request.md and use as the request artifact body anchor.

handoff.description: Single relay-ready leaf handoff. Exactly one of handoff or handoffs must be provided.

handoffs.description: Ordered multi-leaf relay-ready handoffs. Exactly one of handoff or handoffs must be provided.

readiness.description: Request-level readiness scores copied to the request artifact frontmatter.

next_action.description: Optional producer hint for the immediate next relay step. persist-request.js currently persists relay_plan after a successful handoff freeze.

stringArray.description: Array of strings. Empty arrays are allowed when there is nothing to list.

readiness.description: Readiness dimensions used by relay-ready to explain whether the request is clear, leaf-sized, dependency-aware, verifiable, and risk-bounded.

clarity.description: How clearly the request states the desired behavior and constraints.

granularity.description: Whether the request is already one relay-sized task, multiple tasks, or unclear.

dependency.description: Whether the request has no dependencies, internal dependencies, or external dependencies.

verifiability.description: How directly a reviewer can verify completion from the Done Criteria and handoff.

risk.description: Implementation and review risk for the request.

RequestArtifact.description: Persisted request artifact frontmatter written to ~/.relay/requests/<repo-slug>/<request-id>.md. All fields are optional in this definition because preflight and relay-ready artifacts may be partially populated over time.

request_id.description: Request identifier set by the persister.

state.description: Current request artifact state, such as relay_ready.

leaf_id.description: Single-leaf identifier when the request resolves to one relay-ready leaf.

leaf_count.description: Number of relay-ready leaf handoffs persisted for this request.

next_action.description: Immediate next relay action for the orchestrator.

readiness.description: Request-level readiness scores copied from the accepted relay-ready contract.

paths.description: Persisted artifact paths. Single-leaf requests use paths.handoff and a string paths.done_criteria; multi-leaf requests use paths.handoffs and an array paths.done_criteria.

done_criteria.description: Frozen Done Criteria path for a single-leaf request, or ordered Done Criteria paths for a multi-leaf request.

decomposition.description: Multi-leaf ordering and dependency graph consumed by downstream relay phases.

dependencies.description: Map of leaf_id to the leaf_id values it depends on.

HandoffArtifact.description: YAML frontmatter of the persisted relay-ready/<leaf-id>.md handoff artifact. The markdown body of the handoff additionally contains rendered sections for in_scope, out_of_scope, assumptions, done_criteria_markdown, and escalation_conditions — those are body content, not frontmatter, and are covered by the input handoff schema during persistence.

leaf_id.description: Stable leaf identifier used by relay-plan, relay-dispatch, and review anchors.

goal.description: Concrete outcome this leaf must achieve.

order.description: Positive execution order for this leaf.

depends_on.description: Optional list of earlier leaf_id values that must be completed before this leaf.

done_criteria_path.description: Frozen Done Criteria snapshot path for this leaf.

leafHandoffBase.description: Fields shared by a relay-ready leaf handoff. Unknown leaf metadata is allowed so producers can add forward-compatible annotations.

leaf_id.description: Stable leaf identifier used by relay-plan, relay-dispatch, and review anchors.

goal.description: Concrete outcome this leaf must achieve.

order.description: Positive execution order. Required for multi-leaf handoffs; single-leaf handoffs default to 1 when omitted for existing producer compatibility.

depends_on.description: Optional list of earlier leaf_id values that must be completed before this leaf.

in_scope.description: Optional work explicitly included in this leaf. Defaults to an empty list when omitted.

out_of_scope.description: Optional work explicitly excluded from this leaf. Defaults to an empty list when omitted.

assumptions.description: Optional assumptions that make the handoff relay-ready. Defaults to an empty list when omitted.

done_criteria_markdown.description: Frozen Done Criteria markdown that will be written to done-criteria/<leaf-id>.md.

escalation_conditions.description: Optional conditions that should stop execution and escalate back to the orchestrator. Defaults to an empty list when omitted.

readiness.description: Optional leaf-level readiness scores. When present, they must not conflict with other leaf or request readiness values.

singleLeafHandoff.description: Single-leaf handoff. Producers should provide order explicitly, but persistRequestContract normalizes a missing order to 1 for this form.

multiLeafHandoff.description: Multi-leaf handoff item. order is required so decomposition.leaf_order and dependency validation are deterministic.
